bugs_filed.summary: Filters drawer declares aria-haspopup="dialog" but the panel has role=null, no aria-modal and no accessible name; Escape does not close it and focus is never restored. Its own two child date pickers correctly set role="dialog" plus a name, so the panel is the outlier inside the same PR.

Breadcrumb slash separators lack aria-hidden on these routes while /catalog and PDP both set it, converting a harmless 2.52:1 decorative glyph into announced under-contrast content. Also a genuine vs. DESIGN drift - the design spec declares aria-hidden="true".

Zero-match filter hides the active status filter and its control: the drawer gates the status group on v-if="statuses.length" where statuses is a facet-derived prop, while draft/applied.statuses keep the selection - so the term stays in the query with no control to clear it.
bugs_filed.layer_isolation: Paired API probe: with NO status filter, an impossible date window still empties term_facets (totalCount 0 -> 0 facets), so the API drops facets because the result set is empty, not because of the selection. Own-axis independence separately confirmed (status:"Processing" leaves all four status counts intact at 5 results). API therefore defensible; the frontend owns it.
bugs_filed.rca_anchor: client-app/modules/sales-rep/components/sales-rep-orders-filters.vue - v-if="statuses.length" on .sales-rep-orders-filters__statuses (same exposure on the adjacent v-if="customers.length")

bugs_not_filed.summary: salesRepCustomerOrder(id:) localizes statusDisplayValue but not total/subTotal.formattedAmount ($118.00 under de-DE), while the sibling list query returns 118,00 $ for the same order and culture. Standard xAPI order(id:) behaves identically — shared single-order resolver in vc-module-x-order, not PR #14.

after-offset beyond ES index.max_result_window returns HTTP 200 with data null + errors[{code:SEARCH}]. Boundary measured exactly: after 9998 first 2 (=10000) clean, after 9999 first 2 (=10001) errors; negative after errors the same way. Standard orders() is byte-identical. Asymmetry worth noting: the module's non-index siblings degrade gracefully instead.

Omitting storeId aggregates across stores (95 vs 94 with storeId=B2B-store; the extra row is an Electronics-store order). Supplied storeId is honoured and a bogus value fails closed. The documented xAPI ambient-context-args hazard; membership scope still holds, so no cross-org leak.

An unrecognized FILTER field silently yields 0 results (no error), whereas an unrecognized FACET is dropped leaving the result set intact, and an unrecognized SORT field is silently ignored. Shared phrase-parser/index behaviour. Compounded by the design note below: the new surface ships no filter/sort discovery query, so the storefront hardcodes the grammar and a drift renders as 'no orders' rather than an error.
VIS-08: 20px status-filter checkboxes vs the 44px house rule - WCAG 2.5.8 AA still PASSES via 38px centre spacing, so a house-rule deviation, not an SC breach.
VIS-09: .vc-chip__content padding 7.008px, the only off-grid value found; same on /account/orders chips.

VIS-10: the new orders table has no <caption> while /account/orders and /company/members both do. Kept Low deliberately - headers carry scope="col", aria-sort implemented, no SC strictly breached; NOT graded up to clear the floor.

Grid view state (page/filter/sort) is neither URL- nor history-addressable: refresh resets to default, Back does not undo paging, a filtered view cannot be bookmarked or shared. Root cause behind SR-CO-014/017 and partly 005.
Shared header: every language-selector option flag img alt is the CURRENT locale, so the two English variants are indistinguishable to a screen reader. Corroborated by two independent lanes.
The unserved-org 404 guard renders an empty breadcrumb segment ("My customers / / Orders"). Cosmetic.

Two other popovers on the same page DO set role="dialog", so the component supports it and this instance omits it.
invariant_failures.evidence: aria-controls target resolved and inspected; 2x browser_press_key Escape; activeElement remained a non-interactive div.vc-popover
invariant_failures.provenance_control_result: CORRECTION to the first report: the two role="dialog" popovers are NOT 'two other popovers on the page' — they are aria-label="Calendar", i.e. the Filters drawer's OWN two date-picker calendars. The same vc-popover component also correctly emits role="tooltip" (status chips) and role="menu" + aria-label (mega-menu) on this page.
invariant_failures.provenance_conclusion: Strongest IN-SCOPE evidence in the set: within the same feature and the same PR, the CHILD calendars set role=dialog + an accessible name while the PARENT panel containing them sets neither, and no Escape handler or focus restore is wired. The component supports the semantics; this instance omits them. Sub-task of VCST-5733.

invariant_failures.finding: Breadcrumb links fail target size AT 375px ONLY: Home 37.2x17, Account 51.2x17, My customers 86.7x17 — insufficient size AND insufficient neighbour spacing. Identical 17px height at 1920 does NOT fail, so the defect is the cramped narrow-viewport spacing, not the height alone.
invariant_failures.evidence: axe target-size serious, 3 nodes at 375; 0 violations for the same links at 1920
invariant_failures.provenance_control: Two controls at 375px: a 3-link catalog category breadcrumb AND a 5-level PDP breadcrumb (11 crumb items, list wrapped to 72px)
invariant_failures.provenance_control_result: The 3-link catalog breadcrumb produced ZERO target-size violations. The deep PDP breadcrumb reproduced the defect exactly: 3 link nodes flagged, same 17px heights (37.2x17, 47.5x17, 118.9x17), same 'insufficient size AND insufficient space' message.

invariant_failures.finding: The breadcrumb slash separator has NO aria-hidden, while the design spec explicitly declares aria-hidden="true" for it. So "/" is announced to AT, and at #a3a3a3 on #ffffff = 2.52:1 light / #6e6e6e on #0a0a0a = 3.88:1 dark it is also under 4.5:1. Either branch is a defect: exposed content failing 1.4.3, or decoration that must be hidden and is not. Spec and WCAG agree here.
invariant_failures.evidence: li.vc-breadcrumbs__item > span.vc-breadcrumbs__slash, aria-hidden attribute null; ratios computed both modes
invariant_failures.provenance_control: Catalog category page AND deep PDP, both at 375px
invariant_failures.provenance_control_result: BOTH pre-existing surfaces set aria-hidden="true" on .vc-breadcrumbs__slash. The Sales Rep hub routes leave it null. The 2.52:1 colour (#a3a3a3 on #ffffff) is identical on all three.
invariant_failures.provenance_conclusion: SPLIT PROVENANCE, and the split is the finding. The slash CONTRAST is pre-existing but harmless where the element is aria-hidden (decorative, conveys nothing). Omitting aria-hidden on these routes is what converts a harmless decorative element into exposed, announced, under-contrast content. The omission is IN-SCOPE. Also a genuine vs. DESIGN DRIFT: preview/vc-breadcrumbs.html explicitly declares aria-hidden="true", the component honours it elsewhere, and these routes do not — the one place an invariant failure and a spec drift coincide and agree. Sub-task of VCST-5733.

invariant_failures.finding: Pagination ACTIVE page chip fails AA in DARK MODE ONLY: #0a0a0a on #d34247 = 4.37:1 (12px/700, needs 4.5). Light mode is 4.59:1 PASS. Inactive pages 18.64:1, Previous 7.3:1, Next 11.12:1 all PASS. This CONFIRMS and localises attempt 2's unverified fragment.

Indirect evidence points PRE-EXISTING: both colours are global theme tokens, not page-local literals — #d34247 IS the dark-mode --color-primary-500 and #0a0a0a is the dark additional-50 — so a page-specific cause is unlikely. But that is an inference, not the reproduction test, so provenance is left for 5a. If it matters, the cheap resolution is to seed >10 rows on any pre-existing paginated list and re-measure in dark mode.

invariant_failures.finding: The four status-filter checkboxes are 20px tall against the 44x44 mobile house threshold at <=768px (edge gap 18px satisfies the >=8px half). IMPORTANT: WCAG 2.5.8 AA PASSES via the spacing exception (38px centre-to-centre >= 24px), so this is mobile ergonomics, NOT a legal-risk item — recorded so it is not mistaken for an AA failure.
invariant_failures.provenance_control_result: Pre-existing facet checkboxes are also 20px tall (136x20, 111.5x20, 157.8x20) — the same shared vc-checkbox control height.
invariant_failures.provenance_conclusion: Shared UI-kit control size. Stated plainly: WCAG 2.5.8 AA PASSES via the spacing exception (38px centre-to-centre >= 24px), so this is a HOUSE-RULE deviation (BL-UI-006's 44px mobile guidance, also WCAG 2.5.5 AAA) and NOT a WCAG AA failure or a legal-risk item. Graded Low on that basis, which places it below the 5d floor — stated explicitly rather than inflated to clear the floor.

advisory.precedence_ruling: A spec that contradicts a WCAG criterion is AMBIGUOUS and escalates — never resolved by obeying the spec (BL-A11Y/BL-UI invariant > design spec > UX heuristic).
advisory.scope: Property of the SPEC, design-system-wide. Whether the customer-orders status chips actually RESOLVE to these two variants is UNVERIFIED — that measurement was the killed lane's job. OUT-OF-SCOPE for this ticket; contributes no FAIL.

advisory.finding: Payment required chip border #fc9e00 on white = 2.09:1, below 1.4.11's 3:1. Same orange family as the spec's failing chip_solid_primary.

The 'Sales Rep hub' breadcrumb IS the spec-sanctioned mixed-routes span-as-link: <span class="vc-breadcrumbs__link">, link-blue #2563eb at 5.17:1, but cursor:auto, tabIndex -1, no href — looks clickable, is not, and is skipped by keyboard. The chip truncation tooltip is hover-only: .vc-popover__trigger has tabIndex -1 and the chip has no aria-describedby. AT is unaffected because the chip's DOM text is complete (CSS truncation only) — but a sighted keyboard-only user cannot reveal a truncated chip. Verified the tooltip text is identical to the chip label, so no information is exclusive to it.
The date-picker calendars are <table> elements whose day-of-week <th> carry no scope, and whose <tr> use display:grid — which overrides the implicit table row/column semantics in the a11y tree.
The global header theme toggle is 20x20 px (below 2.5.8's 24x24). Global header component, outside this ticket's surface; recorded as an incidental out-of-scope observation.
Filter state is not reflected in the URL — applying filters leaves /company/customer-orders unchanged, so deep-link, refresh-mid-flow and Back-after-filter all lose the applied state (UIP-shaped).
Live --color-warning-500 resolves to #fc9e00, whereas the spec's chip_solid_primary declares #f99e24. Adjacent but not equal — handed over as input to the vs. DESIGN token diff, not adjudicated here.

breadcrumbs.structure: <nav aria-label=Breadcrumb> wrapping <ol class=vc-breadcrumbs__list>; each crumb an <li class=__item>; a SEPARATE <li> holds each slash; last crumb is plain <li> with no link and no trailing separator

breadcrumbs.narrow_width: flex-wrap — it WRAPS; not truncation, not horizontal scroll
breadcrumbs.load_bearing_risk: The spec explicitly sanctions a MIXED-ROUTES pattern in which a non-routed crumb renders as <span class=vc-breadcrumbs__link> — carrying link styling but NOT clickable. A customer-name crumb built that way would be spec-conformant AND defeat AC-5 (return to the customer profile). Precedence resolves that against the spec, so the measurement needed is the ELEMENT TYPE (a vs span) rather than whether it looks like a link. Unmeasured.

a11y_deferral_decision.decision: Accessibility findings do not block this ticket. Product-owner call, recorded rather than inferred.
a11y_deferral_decision.rationale: Filing and failing are separate decisions in this pipeline - a Medium files without failing the ticket, and by the same logic a High can file without blocking. The findings stay open and scheduled; only the verdict grading changed.
a11y_deferral_decision.mechanics: Both findings were re-raised as STANDALONE Bugs in the active sprint (VCST Sprint 26-17, id 2714, field customfield_10021) assigned to Maya Diachkovskaia, so they are schedulable independently of VCST-5733. The original sub-tasks could NOT be converted in place: Jira refused subtask -> Bug with HTTP 400 and the message that the issue type selected is invalid, because that requires the Move operation which the API does not expose. Each sub-task was therefore linked Duplicate to its replacement, commented with the reason, and Cancelled - so no duplicate pair is left open.
a11y_deferral_decision.transition_history_caveat: Reaching Tested from Reopen required walking Reopen -> In progress -> In review -> Ready for test -> Testing -> Tested, because this workflow offers no direct path. Those four intermediate transitions are MECHANICAL, not events: no code was re-worked, no review was performed, no second test cycle ran. Stated in a tracker comment so the history is not misread later.
